name.description: Name should be a verified domain.
name.rationale: The domain name controls what external domain is mapped to the Cloud Run service. Using an unapproved domain can cause traffic misrouting or expose the wrong service.

spec.rationale: The spec block controls routing, certificate mode, and override behaviour for the domain mapping.

force_override.description: If set, the mapping will override any mapping set before this spec was set.
force_override.rationale: Force override can replace an existing mapping and may cause accidental service disruption or incorrect traffic routing.

route_name.description: The name of the Cloud Run Service that this DomainMapping applies to. The route must exist.
route_name.rationale: The route name decides which Cloud Run service receives traffic from the mapped domain. It should only point to an approved service.

certificate_mode.description: The mode of the certificate. Default value is AUTOMATIC. Possible values are NONE and AUTOMATIC.
certificate_mode.rationale: Using AUTOMATIC helps ensure certificates are managed properly. Using NONE can leave the mapped domain without proper certificate handling.

location.description: The location of the Cloud Run instance.
location.rationale: Location should be restricted to approved regions to support data residency and organisational security requirements.

metadata.rationale: Metadata supports ownership, governance, tracking, and correct project alignment.

labels.description: Map of string keys and values used to organise and categorise resources.
labels.rationale: Labels help identify environment, ownership, and governance requirements.

generation.description: (Output) A sequence number representing a specific generation of the desired state.
generation.rationale: This is an output field generated by the provider and is not directly configured by the user.

resource_version.description: (Output) An internal version value used to identify changes to the resource.
resource_version.rationale: This is an output field generated by the provider and is not suitable for a user-defined security policy.

self_link.rationale: This is an output field generated by the provider.

uid.description: (Output) A unique ID generated by the server after resource creation.
uid.rationale: This is generated by the server and cannot be directly configured as a preventive policy input.

namespace.description: In Cloud Run the namespace must be equal to either the project ID or project number.
namespace.rationale: An incorrect namespace can cause resource misalignment or deployment issues.

annotations.description: Key-value metadata stored with a resource, often used by tools for tracking and additional context.
annotations.rationale: Annotations can be used for security ticket tracking and change accountability.

terraform_labels.description: (Output) The combination of labels configured directly on the resource and default labels configured on the provider.
terraform_labels.rationale: This is an output field generated from configured labels and provider defaults.

effective_labels.description: (Output) All labels present on the resource in GCP.
effective_labels.rationale: This is an output field showing the resulting labels after creation.

effective_annotations.description: (Output) All annotations present on the resource in GCP.
effective_annotations.rationale: This is an output field showing the resulting annotations after creation.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
project.rationale: Using an approved project prevents resources being deployed into incorrect or unauthorised environments.
